notes: 02: metadata fetch collects only title+description (extractMetadata); no favicon or preview image. 04: url/title/description/tags editable but no note field exists in model or edit form. 07: card shows title/description/tags/hostname text but no favicon. 12: store.list searches title/description/tags only — url and note not searched (note not stored). 14: no #tag syntax parsing; '#foo' won't match normalized tags. 15: no AND/OR/NOT/parentheses parsing; plain substring match. 16: no quoted-phrase exact match. 20/21: no multi-select or bulk-action code (single-item ops only). 22: list is hardcoded sorted by createdAt desc; no user-selectable sort key or sort control/API param. 23: no markdown note field or rendering. 24/25: no local HTML/PDF snapshot or Internet Archive support. 26/27/28: no archived flag, no archive view, no archive-vs-delete distinction. 29: no bundle/saved-filter persistence. 30/31: no Netscape HTML import or export. 32: no user settings (default sort/items/font size); only a Google Fonts import in CSS.
